reading: Tear gas was used in Paris and Marseille as school protests grew across France.
Initially, crowds consisting mainly of teenagers called for more resources for schools and an end to what they characterized as police repression.
Hundreds of thousands of people have taken to the streets across France, as a wave of protests by high-school pupils spread to their parents, university students and unions.
The government reported that over 250,000 demonstrators participated on Tuesday, with disruptions in almost a quarter of all lycées.

Students' unions, however, claimed significantly higher numbers, putting total demonstrators at 450,000 and blockaded high schools at 1,800 on what the protesters dubbed "Act Three" of their movement.
Police clashed with demonstrators in Lyon, using tear gas in Paris and Marseille and water cannon in Rennes, though serious trouble was less severe than in previous protests.
Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu condemned earlier violence, reporting 215 students, 85 staff, and 715 police officers had been hurt since the protests began.
Education Minister Édouard Geffray appealed for dialogue over school blockades and warned against "ultra-violent elements" infiltrating student movements.
Alissa described schools as “falling apart”, conditions she saw as necessitating protests.
Her friend, Sacha, further detailed poor conditions, including leaking ceilings in Marseille's schools, hindering effective study.
Widespread concern exists over allegations of "disproportionate force" by police, with France's IGPN police inspectorate investigating multiple cases.
One police officer has been charged by prosecutors with "violence... resulting in mutilation or permanent disability" after firing a tear-gas grenade at a high school student.
Another alarming incident involved a 15-year-old's hand being torn off after a so-called anti-encirclement grenade was fired in unclear circumstances near a school in Lens.
Government efforts, including a website for grievances and internal school discussions, have made little impression on the students so far.
With further union-backed mobilisations anticipated, the current wave of discontent appears unlikely to abate in the near future.
Alain and Michèle, former teachers in their seventies, joined the Paris march, explaining that they understood the education system’s problems.

vocabulary.definition: Described the distinctive nature or features of something or someone.
The act of suppressing something or someone by force, often with a sense of injustice or oppression.
Given a particular name or nickname to something or someone.
Made a serious and urgent request for discussion and negotiation to resolve a situation.
Entering or gaining access to an organization or place surreptitiously and often with hostile intent.
Making something necessary as a result or consequence of a particular situation.
Claims that someone has done something wrong; the word itself does not establish whether the claims are supported or proved.
Formally accused by legal officials of committing a crime, leading to legal proceedings.
Conditions or details surrounding an event that are not fully known, understood, or transparent.
An effect or feeling produced on someone's mind, often initially or subtly, by an experience or event.
Not likely to become less intense, widespread, or severe in the near future.

entries.ja: 何かや誰かの特徴的な性質や特徴を説明した。
entries.ko: 어떤 것이나 누군가의 독특한 본질이나 특징을 묘사했습니다.
entries.zh-Hans: 描述了某事或某人的独特性质或特征。
entries.es: Describió la naturaleza o las características distintivas de algo o alguien.
entries.pt-BR: Descreveu a natureza ou as características distintivas de algo ou alguém.
entries.fr: Décrit la nature ou les caractéristiques distinctives de quelque chose ou de quelqu'un.
entries.de: Beschrieb die charakteristische Art oder die Merkmale von etwas oder jemandem.

entries.ja: 力によって何かや誰かを抑圧する行為で、しばしば不公正や抑圧の感覚を伴うもの。
entries.ko: 무력으로 어떤 것이나 누군가를 억압하는 행위로, 종종 불의나 억압의 느낌을 동반합니다.
entries.zh-Hans: 以武力压制某事或某人的行为，通常带有不公正或压迫感。
entries.es: El acto de suprimir algo o a alguien por la fuerza, a menudo con un sentido de injusticia u opresión.
entries.pt-BR: O ato de suprimir algo ou alguém pela força, frequentemente com um sentimento de injustiça ou opressão.
entries.fr: L'acte de supprimer quelque chose ou quelqu'un par la force, souvent avec un sentiment d'injustice ou d'oppression.
entries.de: Der Akt, etwas oder jemanden mit Gewalt zu unterdrücken, oft mit einem Gefühl der Ungerechtigkeit oder Unterdrückung.

entries.ja: 何かや誰かに特定の名前やニックネームが付けられた。
entries.ko: 어떤 것이나 누군가에게 특정한 이름이나 별명이 붙여졌습니다.
entries.zh-Hans: 给某事或某人起了特定的名称或绰号。
entries.es: Dio un nombre o apodo particular a algo o a alguien.
entries.pt-BR: Deu um nome ou apelido específico a algo ou alguém.
entries.fr: Donné un nom ou un surnom particulier à quelque chose ou à quelqu'un.
entries.de: Etwas oder jemandem einen bestimmten Namen oder Spitznamen gegeben.

entries.ja: 状況を解決するために、話し合いと交渉を真剣かつ緊急に要請した。
entries.ko: 상황을 해결하기 위해 토론과 협상을 진지하고 긴급하게 요청했습니다.
entries.zh-Hans: 为解决某种情况而发出认真而紧急的讨论和谈判请求。
entries.es: Hizo una solicitud seria y urgente de discusión y negociación para resolver una situación.
entries.pt-BR: Fez um pedido sério e urgente de discussão e negociação para resolver uma situação.
entries.fr: A fait une demande sérieuse et urgente de discussion et de négociation pour résoudre une situation.
entries.de: Hat eine ernsthafte und dringende Bitte um Diskussion und Verhandlungen zur Lösung einer Situation geäußert.

entries.ja: 秘密裏に、そしてしばしば敵意を持って組織や場所に入り込むこと、またはそこにアクセスすること。
entries.ko: 비밀스럽게, 그리고 종종 적대적인 의도를 가지고 조직이나 장소에 침투하거나 접근하는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 秘密地，通常怀有敌意地进入或获得进入某个组织或地方。
entries.es: Entrar o acceder a una organización o lugar subrepticiamente y a menudo con intenciones hostiles.
entries.pt-BR: Entrar ou obter acesso a uma organização ou lugar de forma sorrateira e frequentemente com intenção hostil.
entries.fr: Entrer ou obtenir l'accès à une organisation ou un lieu subrepticement et souvent avec une intention hostile.
entries.de: Heimlich und oft mit feindlicher Absicht in eine Organisation oder an einen Ort eindringen oder sich Zugang verschaffen.

entries.ja: 特定の状況の結果として何かを必要とさせること。
entries.ko: 특정 상황의 결과로 어떤 것을 필요하게 만드는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 由于特定情况的结果，使某事变得必要。
entries.es: Hacer que algo sea necesario como resultado o consecuencia de una situación particular.
entries.pt-BR: Tornar algo necessário como resultado ou consequência de uma situação específica.
entries.fr: Rendre quelque chose nécessaire à la suite ou en conséquence d'une situation particulière.
entries.de: Etwas aufgrund oder als Folge einer bestimmten Situation notwendig machen.

entries.ja: 誰かが不正を行ったという主張。この語だけでは、根拠があるか、証明されているかは分からない。
entries.ko: 누군가 잘못을 저질렀다는 주장. 이 단어만으로는 주장을 뒷받침하는 근거가 있는지 또는 입증되었는지 알 수 없다.
entries.zh-Hans: 指称某人有不当行为的说法；这个词本身并不能说明这些说法是否有依据或已获证实。
entries.es: Afirmaciones de que alguien ha hecho algo indebido; la palabra por sí sola no indica si tienen respaldo o se han probado.
entries.pt-BR: Afirmações de que alguém fez algo errado; a palavra, por si só, não indica se há evidências que as sustentem ou se foram comprovadas.
entries.fr: Affirmations selon lesquelles une personne a commis un acte répréhensible ; le mot seul ne dit pas si elles sont étayées ou prouvées.
entries.de: Behauptungen, jemand habe etwas Unrechtes getan; das Wort allein sagt nicht, ob sie durch Belege gestützt oder bewiesen sind.

entries.ja: 法的な関係者によって犯罪を犯したとして正式に告発され、法的手続きにつながること。
entries.ko: 범죄를 저질렀다고 법률 관계자들에게 공식적으로 기소되어 법적 절차가 시작되는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 被法律官员正式指控犯有罪行，从而导致法律诉讼。
entries.es: Acusado formalmente por funcionarios legales de cometer un crimen, lo que lleva a procedimientos legales.
entries.pt-BR: Acusado formalmente por autoridades legais de cometer um crime, levando a processos judiciais.
entries.fr: Accusé formellement par des fonctionnaires de justice d'avoir commis un crime, menant à des procédures légales.
entries.de: Von Justizbeamten formell eines Verbrechens beschuldigt werden, was zu rechtlichen Schritten führt.

entries.ja: ある出来事を取り巻く状況や詳細が、完全に知られていない、理解されていない、または透明ではないこと。
entries.ko: 어떤 사건을 둘러싼 상황이나 세부 사항이 완전히 알려지거나 이해되거나 투명하지 않은 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 围绕某个事件的条件或细节不完全为人所知、理解或不透明。
entries.es: Condiciones o detalles que rodean un evento que no son completamente conocidos, comprendidos o transparentes.
entries.pt-BR: Condições ou detalhes que cercam um evento que não são totalmente conhecidos, compreendidos ou transparentes.
entries.fr: Conditions ou détails entourant un événement qui ne sont pas entièrement connus, compris ou transparents.
entries.de: Umstände oder Details eines Ereignisses, die nicht vollständig bekannt, verstanden oder transparent sind.

entries.ja: 経験や出来事によって、しばしば最初または微妙に、誰かの心に生じる効果や感情。
entries.ko: 경험이나 사건으로 인해 누군가의 마음에 종종 처음으로 또는 미묘하게 생기는 영향이나 느낌.
entries.zh-Hans: 某种经历或事件在某人心中产生的影响或感觉，通常是初步的或微妙的。
entries.es: Un efecto o sentimiento producido en la mente de alguien, a menudo inicialmente o sutilmente, por una experiencia o evento.
entries.pt-BR: Um efeito ou sentimento produzido na mente de alguém, frequentemente de forma inicial ou sutil, por uma experiência ou evento.
entries.fr: Un effet ou un sentiment produit dans l'esprit de quelqu'un, souvent initialement ou subtilement, par une expérience ou un événement.
entries.de: Ein Effekt oder Gefühl, das im Geist einer Person, oft anfänglich oder subtil, durch eine Erfahrung oder ein Ereignis hervorgerufen wird.

entries.ja: 近い将来、激しさ、広がり、または深刻さが軽減される可能性が低いこと。
entries.ko: 가까운 미래에 강도, 확산 또는 심각성이 줄어들 가능성이 없는 것.
entries.zh-Hans: 在不久的将来，不太可能变得不那么强烈、不那么普遍或不那么严重。
entries.es: No es probable que disminuya su intensidad, extensión o gravedad en un futuro próximo.
entries.pt-BR: Não é provável que se torne menos intenso, generalizado ou grave no futuro próximo.
entries.fr: Il est peu probable que cela devienne moins intense, moins répandu ou moins grave dans un avenir proche.
entries.de: Wird in naher Zukunft wahrscheinlich nicht weniger intensiv, verbreitet oder schwerwiegend werden.

review.method: Codex multilingual editorial update; unchanged definitions retained after review of their use in the revised reading; no paid translation or new independent model review
